status: Prospective local specification before this stage's calculations; post-selection exploratory sensitivity analysis, not preregistration
candidate_set: The 15 existing primary one-to-one orthologues in the stage08 mouse candidate table, in archived human order; no reselection
difference_from_prior: Stage04 already omitted one library per group in all 27 combinations with re-estimated human factors. Stage05 already reported group medians, pseudocount sensitivity and pairwise ordering. This extension uses every choice retaining 2 or 3 libraries per group (64 combinations), covers mouse as well as human, compares 4096 cross-species combination pairs without artificial library pairing, and computes all-expression-filtered-gene PCA instead of the prior human top-500 PCA.

primary.human: Median-ratio-normalized gene counts, positive-in-all-active-library reference genes; factors re-estimated for each combination, log2((group summary A + 1)/(group summary B + 1))
primary.mouse: Deposited stage08 gene TPM, no subset renormalization, log2((group summary A + 0.1)/(group summary B + 0.1))
primary.combinations: For each of three groups: keep all three or omit exactly one of three; 4^3=64 including unperturbed data
primary.summaries: Arithmetic mean (primary) and median (sensitivity); median of two observations equals mean
primary.direction: sign of contrast; exact zero remains unchanged; a zero is never agreement with a nonzero sign
primary.cross_species: Cartesian product of the 64 human and 64 mouse combinations, 4096 descriptive combinations; report separate model/intervention concordance and their intersection, and preservation of the archived concordant nonzero signs
primary.scope: Direction retention; does not reapply human candidate-selection thresholds or define a new candidate list

sensitivity: Human median-ratio factors frozen at all-nine-library values to isolate sample composition
Human CPM with all assigned counts as the denominator

Mouse estimated gene counts normalized using re-estimated median-ratio factors, pseudocount 1; only a method sensitivity because summed gene estimated counts do not adjust variable transcript-length composition
Report no-pseudocount group percentage differences only where denominator is strictly positive; missing otherwise

qc.human: All genes with CPM >=1 in at least 3 of 9 libraries (original fixed filter), log2(full-data median-ratio count+1)
qc.mouse: All genes with TPM >=1 in at least 3 of 9 libraries, log2(TPM+1)
qc.pca: Separate studies; center genes across all nine libraries; no variance scaling, top-variable-gene selection or candidate selection; exact deterministic SVD, sign-oriented by largest absolute loading
qc.correlation: Pearson and Spearman sample correlations across each study's fixed retained gene set
qc.exclusions: None; report raw assigned or estimated counts, detected genes and duplicate profiles

guardrails: Library is the observed unit; independent cultures or biological replicates remain unresolved
Mouse labels ctrl/HFD/sess retain provisional interpretation; HFD label alone does not establish animal tissue
Overlapping subsets are neither independent repeats, probabilities nor confidence intervals
Same data used for human selection and stability; not independent validation
Shared model groups make two contrasts dependent; no causal rescue or efficacy claim
No P values, FDR, inferential confidence intervals, new biological experiments or AI performance claim
Original data and past artifacts remain read-only; outputs confined to this directory
